The original analysis read copies of these files from the analyst's computer; here each comes from a published URL (see [`references.bib`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/references.bib)).

## ZIP code to HSA

One Dartmouth crosswalk per year, 2011 to 2019. The 2018 and 2019 files are published as zipped CSV rather than Excel; the original reader only looked for Excel files. Each ZIP code and year must appear once.

## ZIP code to ZCTA

ACS data are published by ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA), not by ZIP code. About a fifth of ZIP codes, mostly PO box and large-volume ZIP codes, have no ZCTA of their own and belong to a surrounding ZCTA with a different number. The UDS Mapper crosswalk for each year, bundled in `zippeR` [@zipper_pkg; @uds_crosswalk], maps every ZIP code to its ZCTA. The original analysis intended this step but never applied it; it matched ZIP codes to ZCTAs directly, so residents of those ZIP codes found no ACS data.

**Functions used:** [`standardize_zip()`](functions.qmd#zip-codes), [`assert_unique()`](functions.qmd#unique-keys).

```{r}
#| label: read-zcta-crosswalk
#| eval: false
```

## American Community Survey

ZCTA estimates from the 5-year subject table S0601 for each study year. Every year's variable labels are checked first. The ZCTA code is taken as the last five characters of the Census identifier (`GEOID`), because `tidycensus` removes the two-digit state prefix only for 2013 and later [@tidycensus]; the key is then checked to be unique by ZCTA and year. The estimates are keyed by ZCTA and joined to patients through the crosswalk above.

**Functions used:** [`assert_unique()`](functions.qmd#unique-keys), [`check_acs_labels()`](functions.qmd#checking-acs-variables).

```{r}
#| label: download-acs
#| eval: false
```

## HSA population

The denominator of the exposure: the population of the ZCTAs of the ZIP codes in each HSA that year. Because several ZIP codes can share a ZCTA, each ZCTA is counted once per HSA (`hsa_population_from_zcta()`); summing over ZIP codes would count a shared ZCTA's population several times.

**Functions used:** [`hsa_population_from_zcta()`](functions.qmd#hsa-population).
